title: Probe: Search: a monotone fan-in-two AND/OR formula of depth at most 4 for the edge function of the Petersen graph
plain_statement: Is there, for the Petersen graph on inputs 0..9 (outer cycle 0-1-2-3-4-0, spokes i to i + 5, inner pentagram 5-7-9-6-8-5), a monotone formula of depth at most 4 for the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true? A monotone formula: a tree of fan-in-two AND and OR gates over the inputs, no NOT, no constants; depth at most d is said as: the function lies in level d of every family of sets of functions that holds the inputs at level 0, keeps each level in the next, and puts the AND and the OR of two level-k functions in level k + 1. Conjecture.
